paragraphs.text: March was drier than usual, with 28 millimetres of rain against an average of 51. The warmest day was the 19th, when the temperature reached 21 degrees; the coldest night was on the 4th, at minus 3.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Wind speeds above 60 kilometres an hour were recorded on four days. The station, which has been running since 1959, lost power for two hours during the storm on the 8th, but no data were lost.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: How much rain fell in March?
On which date was the warmest day?
On how many days was the wind above 60 kilometres an hour?
Since which year has the station been running?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
